steps.en: PLUS can send a request to extend a temporary suspension.
steps.id: PLUS bisa mengirim permintaan perpanjangan suspensi sementara.
steps.why_en: There is no dedicated extension request; PLUS has to send a new suspension request instead.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada permintaan perpanjangan khusus; PLUS harus mengirim permintaan suspensi baru.

steps.en: PLUS can ask OCMS to check a request without applying it.
steps.id: PLUS bisa meminta OCMS memeriksa permintaan tanpa menerapkannya.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether the extension can be allowed.
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa apakah perpanjangan boleh dilakukan.
steps.why_en: For a notice already suspended the check says yes without checking anything, while the real run may refuse.
steps.why_id: Untuk notice yang sudah disuspensi, pemeriksaan selalu bilang boleh tanpa cek apa pun, padahal proses nyata bisa menolak.

steps.en: When the extension is actually sent, the notice is checked again.
steps.id: Saat perpanjangan benar-benar dikirim, notice diperiksa ulang.

steps.en: The suspension is extended by the number of days PLUS requested.
steps.id: Suspensi diperpanjang sebanyak hari yang diminta PLUS.
steps.why_en: Days are counted from today, and a shorter request is reported as success without extending anything.
steps.why_id: Hari dihitung dari hari ini, dan permintaan yang lebih pendek dilaporkan berhasil tanpa memperpanjang apa pun.

steps.en: The extended suspension is recorded and keeps the notice suspended.
steps.id: Suspensi yang diperpanjang tercatat dan notice tetap tersuspensi.
steps.why_en: The extension is stored as a plain new suspension, with no extension record, reason or count.
steps.why_id: Perpanjangan disimpan sebagai suspensi baru biasa, tanpa catatan, alasan atau hitungan perpanjangan.

steps.en: PLUS gets an answer for each notice in the extension request.
steps.id: PLUS menerima jawaban untuk tiap notice dalam permintaan perpanjangan.
